tables.name: infrastructure_workbook_exports
columns: mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('registration_template','discovery','round_trip'))
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: export is observational and never mutates Infrastructure domain state
operator-managed artifact path/content after export is not lifecycle authority

tables.name: infrastructure_workbook_runs
columns: workbook_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(workbook_mode IN ('registration_template','discovery','round_trip'))
installation_relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(installation_relation IN ('same_installation','foreign_installation'))
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('validating','staged','reviewed','accepted','rejected','failed'))
network_element_row_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(network_element_row_count>=0)
ip_row_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(ip_row_count>=0)
warning_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(warning_count>=0)
published_at_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(published_at_utc IS NULL OR published_at_utc>=captured_at_utc)
last_command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: source workbook remains external/user-managed and is never modified
same file/logical replay is idempotently recognized

tables.name: infrastructure_workbook_staging_rows
columns: workbook_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES infrastructure_workbook_runs(workbook_run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
sheet_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(sheet_kind IN ('network_elements','ip_addresses'))
validation_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(validation_state IN ('valid','warning','invalid'))
rules: normalized JSON uses closed versioned schema and contains only allowlisted workbook values; no secrets/formulas/whole XML/cell objects
may be removed after terminal run decision once bounded row-decision evidence is persisted

tables.name: infrastructure_workbook_proposals
columns: workbook_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES infrastructure_workbook_runs(workbook_run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
staging_row_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES infrastructure_workbook_staging_rows(staging_row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('create_network_element','update_network_element','create_related_reference','update_ip_set','unchanged','skip_invalid','ambiguous','unknown_reference','relationship_change'))
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','accepted','rejected','superseded'))
target_network_element_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES network_elements(network_element_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
expected_target_revision INTEGER NULL CHECK(expected_target_revision IS NULL OR expected_target_revision>0)
last_command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: technical non-authoritative review intent and intentionally cascades with its staging row after terminal durable row decisions exist
same-installation immutable local identity may target exactly one existing Network Element; foreign identity never directly authorizes target
material Site/placement/Cloud/containment/model/IP changes remain explicit in impact JSON

tables.name: infrastructure_workbook_row_decisions
columns: workbook_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES infrastructure_workbook_runs(workbook_run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
sheet_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(sheet_kind IN ('network_elements','ip_addresses'))
disposition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(disposition IN ('created','updated','unchanged','rejected','skipped_invalid','ambiguous','unknown_reference','failed'))
target_network_element_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES network_elements(network_element_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: bounded durable row-decision evidence survives staging cleanup
no full source row copy required after terminal decision
result refs use closed identifiers only

tables.name: infrastructure_workbook_replay_index
columns: accepted_workbook_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES infrastructure_workbook_runs(workbook_run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: accepted identical logical content is idempotent
digest detects content replay and is not authenticity proof

required_indexes: all command/FK columns receive LLD-01 leading-prefix FK coverage
staging_cleanup: After accepted/rejected/failed run reaches terminal evidence and row decisions are persisted, deletion of a technical staging row cascades only its technical proposal payload. Cleanup is forbidden while the run/proposal is pending/reviewable. Run metadata, row fingerprints/decisions, replay index and audit remain.
